name: PS3100XXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Semi-modular poly synth modelled on the 1977 Korg PS-3100 (not affiliated with Korg): one oscillator, filter and envelope per key up to 48 voices, three-peak resonators, ensemble, two modulation generators, sample & hold, twelve temperament knobs and a patch bay you patch by touch, on one zoomable page.
